name: Muha Meds Disposable (3rd Gen) | Watermelon Moonshine
description: Watermelon Moonshine tastes like a summer cookout gone wild—juicy watermelon with a crisp, sweet kick. This hybrid balances euphoric energy with smooth body vibes, so you can laugh with friends or get lost in your own head. Fresh, loud, and juicy every pull.
